title: M6 Stage 3 v2 — Extended-Horizon Frozen M5 Evaluation

campaign_limits.gameplay_wall_budget_scope: Stage 3 v2 only; excludes historical v1 and completed M6 diagnostics
campaign_limits.retry_scope: one global retry only for process-start failure before any ALE action; no reset attempt replacement

schedule_order.paired_policy_order: warm first for even ALE seeds; scratch first for odd ALE seeds
schedule_order.same_seed_use: extended-horizon re-evaluation of the v1 paired seeds; not independent held-out evidence

scientific_interpretation.relationship_to_v1: separately versioned extended-horizon follow-on; never pool v1 and v2 as one unchanged protocol
scientific_interpretation.seed_interpretation: same paired ALE seeds are re-evaluated under a changed horizon and are not independent held-out evidence
scientific_interpretation.primary_endpoint: RGB-verified initiated player moves divided by all initiated player moves
scientific_interpretation.interval_qualification: Wilson interval is descriptive; moves within a game are correlated, so the interval alone is not an independent-reliability guarantee
scientific_interpretation.strength_comparison: exploratory only; no Elo or superiority claim
scientific_interpretation.incomplete_game_accounting: incomplete, truncated, and terminal-unknown attempts are not draws
